description:
Options passed to [`VideoModel::do_start`] and [`VideoModel::do_status`].

Aligned with V4 `VideoModelV4CallOptions`.

duration.description: Duration of the video in seconds. Typically 3–10 seconds.

frameImages.description: Role-tagged image inputs for first-last-frame generation.

generateAudio.description: Whether the model should generate audio alongside the video.

headers.description: Additional HTTP headers to send with the request.

image.description: Input image for image-to-video generation (the starting frame).

inputReferences.description: Reference inputs for reference-to-video generation (images or videos).

maxRetries.description:
Maximum number of retries, the AI SDK's `maxRetries`; `Some(0)` disables
retrying. `None` uses 2, the AI SDK default.

n.description:
Number of videos to generate. Default `1`; most models only support
`n = 1` due to computational cost.

poll.description:
Poll pacing for the start/status flow, the AI SDK's `generateVideo`
`poll` option. Unset fields use the AI SDK defaults (5000 ms between
status checks, 600000 ms in total).

prompt.description: Text prompt for the video generation. `None` when not required.

providerOptions.description: Additional provider-specific options, keyed by provider name.

seed.description: Seed for deterministic generation. `None` uses a random seed.
